units.source_text: 行幸的准备工作完成之后，源氏公子偶尔也去访问常陆亲王家的小姐。

en.t: After the preparations for the imperial outing were complete, Prince Genji would occasionally visit the young lady of Prince Hitachi's household.

units.source_text: 然而他自从迎接了与藤壶妃子有缘的紫姬到二条院来，

en.t: However, ever since he had brought Lady Murasaki, who was connected to Lady Fujitsubo, to the Nijo mansion,

units.source_text: 便溺爱这小姑娘的美貌，连六条妃子那里也难得去访了，

en.t: he had become so devoted to the little girl's beauty that he rarely even visited the lady at Rokujo anymore,
much less the dilapidated residence of Prince Hitachi.

units.source_text: 他始终不忘记她的可怜，

en.t: He never forgot how pitiful she was,

units.source_text: 然而总是懒得去访，这也是无可奈何的事。

en.t: yet he was always too reluctant to visit her, and that too was something that could not be helped.
